# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Write-tool schema drift (the dominant airline cluster)
- What worked (pending RESULT confirmation, cand_0001): the gpt-oss-120b agent systematically sends passenger `date_of_birth` (not `dob`) and payments as `{type,id,amount}` (not `{payment_id,amount}`). The frozen pydantic Passenger/Payment models reject these with "Field required", so writes bounce and the scorer records "expected call was never made" even though the agent DID call the tool. Fix: in-body normalization helpers mapping alias keys → canonical, inside book_reservation / update_reservation_passengers / update_reservation_flights / update_reservation_baggages. Strict no-op on already-correct args (verified against passing task 8's successful call).
- What didn't (not yet tried): n/a.
- Promising but not yet tried: (1) payment auto-balance — on env "amount does not add up, total price is N" with one credit card, set credit = N − sum(others) and retry once (verified flips task 25 to gold). (2) nonfree_baggages recompute from the policy free-allowance table. (3) A bounded cancellation-eligibility predicate for task 19 instead of loosening the global transfer rule.
